items.title: Higher Order Sigma Rules (HOSR): Turning Sigma Alerts into ATT&CK-Mapped Attack Chains
items.summary: Higher Order Sigma Rules (HOSR) are correlation rules that sit one level above standard Sigma detections. Instead of matching a single log event, a Higher Order Sigma rule links the Sigma rules that fire on one host into an attack chain mapped to MITRE ATT&CK. Most SOC teams already run hundreds of Sigma rules. Each flags one suspicious step, such as an encoded PowerShell command or a new service install, but analysts still have to work out which alerts belong to the same intrusion. HOSR moves that reasoning into the detection content itself, so multi-stage attack detection starts before anyon…

When the attack was discovered, several applications were temporarily shut down. At the time, the Commission said it had found no evidence that staff data had been compromised. items.title: Delegate user access to AI agents with Amazon Cognito token exchange
items.summary: Suppose you use a restaurant review app to check reviews, book tables, and email invitations to your friends. With OAuth 2.0 , the app sends you to the authorization server that your email provider trusts, where you sign in and approve only the access the app requested, such as the contacts.read and messages.send scopes. The review app won’t sees your credentials. It only receives a short-lived access token limited to the scopes you approved, which it presents to your email provider’s API to read your contacts and send invitation emails on your behalf. items.title: Ad Tracker RedTrack Breached: Attacker Reached Logs Holding API Keys, Ad Tokens and Certificate Keys
items.summary: An attacker spent the night of 22 November inside the network that runs RedTrack, an ad-tracking platform, and copied data from several of its systems. RedTrack, run by RedTrack Technologies Ltd in Cyprus, told its customers in an email on 24 November. The part with the widest reach is the log store the attacker got into. According to RedTrack, it held API keys, session tokens, advertising-network tokens, private keys of certificates that customers had uploaded, and hashed personal data of people who bought something or signed up after clicking an ad.
